people.name: Ahinoam
people.line: Wife of David, from Jezreel; mother of Amnon

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jezreel
people.line: A town in Judah, home of David's wife Ahinoam

translations.web: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they both became his wives.
translations.bsb: David had also married Ahinoam of Jezreel. So she and Abigail were both his wives.
